spirit:component.spirit:description: The Versal Adaptive SoC 600G Channelized Multirate Ethernet IP core provides a Multirate Ethernet MAC and PCS/PMA upto 600G line rate along with 1x400G, 3x200G and 6x100G line rates with optional KP4 RS-FEC, KR4 RS-FEC and Fiber channel/CPRI FEC. This IP supports high accuracy IEEE 1588v2 1-step and 2-step hardware time stamping.

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: ENABLE_PHASE_FIFO
spirit:parameter.spirit:displayName: Enable Phase Aligned FIFO between DCMAC and GT
